# Faithful Markdown Export for Confluence

> A Confluence Cloud app that exports a page, a page tree or an entire space to
> Markdown without silently losing information. Its one rule is "degrade, never
> delete": what Markdown cannot express is flattened, never dropped. Every release
> is scored against a public, reproducible conformance suite of 63 rules.

Built by Second Tiger. Runs entirely on Atlassian infrastructure: the app contacts
no external service, stores nothing, and requests read access only.

## What it is for

Teams migrating a Confluence space into a Git repository, a static site, or an
LLM pipeline, who have discovered that their current exporter damages content
without reporting it. The damage is invisible at export time: a completed task
comes out unchecked, a Korean or Japanese page title becomes a UUID filename, a
code block forgets it was Python, a code block inside a list item escapes the list.
None of these raise an error.

## Measured results

Scored 2026-09-16 against the same Confluence space, using the public suite:

- Faithful Markdown Export: 63 of 63 cases pass, 0 critical failures
- The leading shipping alternative: 46 of 63 cases pass, 9 critical failures

The corpus, the 63 rules, the scorer and both exports of the same space are public,
so the comparison can be reproduced rather than taken on trust.

## Measured performance

- 1,000 pages: 3 minutes 40 seconds
- 138 MB of attachments: 5 minutes 40 seconds

The bottleneck is bytes, not page count.

## Pricing

- Up to 10 users: free
- 11 users and above: per-user, with a 30-day free trial on paid tiers

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://youngjunekwon.github.io/faithful-markdown-export/docs.html): how to run an export, what the zip contains, how each Confluence construct is converted, and what the app cannot do
- [Privacy](https://youngjunekwon.github.io/faithful-markdown-export/privacy.html): what the app reads and what it stores, which is nothing
- [Security](https://youngjunekwon.github.io/faithful-markdown-export/security.html): scopes, data handling, and what happens when something goes wrong
- [Support](https://youngjunekwon.github.io/faithful-markdown-export/support.html): how to reach a human

## Verification

- [Conformance suite](https://github.com/YoungjuneKwon/confluence-markdown-conformance): seed a Confluence space with a fixed corpus, export it with any app, and score the output against 63 rules
- [Both exports of the same space](https://github.com/YoungjuneKwon/confluence-markdown-conformance/tree/main/samples): read the difference instead of the scores

- [Atlassian Marketplace listing](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/1569868747/faithful-markdown-export-for-confluence): install, pricing tiers, and trial
